parameters.jsCode: const req=$('EONET Request').first().json.body||{}; const lat=Number(req.latitude), lon=Number(req.longitude), radius=Number(req.radiusKm||500); if(!Number.isFinite(lat)||!Number.isFinite(lon)) throw new Error('latitude and longitude required'); const rad=x=>x*Math.PI/180; const dist=(a,b,c,d)=>{const R=6371,dp=rad(c-a),dl=rad(d-b);const h=Math.sin(dp/2)**2+Math.cos(rad(a))*Math.cos(rad(c))*Math.sin(dl/2)**2;return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h));}; const events=($json.events||[]).map(e=>{const g=(e.geometry||[]).slice().reverse().find(x=>x?.type==='Point'&&Array.isArray(x.coordinates)); if(!g)return null; const elon=Number(g.coordinates[0]),elat=Number(g.coordinates[1]),distanceKm=dist(lat,lon,elat,elon); return {id:e.id,title:e.title,description:e.description||'',categories:e.categories||[],sources:e.sources||[],geometry:e.geometry||[],lat:elat,lon:elon,date:g.date,distanceKm:Math.round(distanceKm),link:e.link,closed:e.closed};}).filter(e=>e&&e.distanceKm<=radius).sort((a,b)=>a.distanceKm-b.distanceKm).slice(0,25); return [{json:{ok:true,source:'NASA EONET v3',officialLocalWarning:false,note:'EONET is an open natural-event catalogue and does not replace official local emergency warnings.',query:{latitude:lat,longitude:lon,radiusKm:radius,days:Number(req.days||60)},matched:events.length,events}}];
